balls.text: well how about that for an impact player switch! Slower ball lands full on fourth stump, Gowtham not fooled one bit and channels his inner dark knight by destroying this over wide midwicket landing just past the LCD ad boards.

slower length ball on fourth stump, Badoni shuffles across trying to scoop this over fine leg but is thrown off by the lack of pace and it pings the gloves before ballooning to the left of Sarfaraz, who shuffles five yards and reaches forward for a simple take.
slower ball lands full on middle at 101 kph, Badoni channels the death overs heroics of the guy whose name he rhymes with and crunches a drive high and deep over long-on 10 rows back.
full in the slot, winds up and clobbers this high and deep over wide long-on.
slower bouncer at 113 kph, too high and wide called on height.
full on fifth stump, heaves a drive down the ground for one.
slides this slower ball wide outside off, left alone, wide called.
full on the stumps, driven down the ground for one.
full on fifth stump, slashes at this to the cover sweeper for one.

slower bouncer on fifth stump, left alone and called a wide from square leg. Sarfaraz signals to Warner that he wants to review the wide. Warner laughs and says no. Hmmm.... It was a tight call. Worth it under the new rules.
length ball wide outside off, opens the face to guide this behind point but picks out the fielder on the ring.
length ball on fifth stump, slams a pull over wide midwicket to the rope.

fullish length ball outside off, smokes a drive flat to Prithvi in the ring at extra cover. He catches it in self-preservation at waist height. Absolute howitzer off the bat of Pooran but he couldn't have picked out Shaw any better.
length ball wide outside off at 123 kph, opens the face to guide this behind point for two.

shot of the day! Well, tied with the similar one Mayers laced over extra cover for six. Length ball on seventh stump, Pooran powers this flat over the extra cover rope. Sharp catch by a ground staff member.
waist height full toss at 138 kph on off stump, prodded gently to long-off for one.
length ball on the wide guideline, slaps this tennis racquet style wide of long-off, diving stop by Prithvi to save two runs.
full and wide, speared outside the guideline, wide called.

full on sixth stump, Pooran pulverizes a drive straight into Krunal's knee at the non-striker's end. He was still facing Pooran so was hit on the front of the pads. No harm done, except if you're Pooran and just were robbed of runs.
full and wide at 136 kph, driven down the ground to long-off for one.
full on fifth stump, driven down the ground to long-on for one.
fullish length ball wide outside off, scuffs a drive down the ground for one.
length ball with pace off at 100 kph wide outside off, chops a bottom edge into the off side for a single.
length ball on fifth stump at full pace 129 kph, cross bat swat barely clears Warner leaping up at long-on.
another slower ball lands on a fullish length on the wide guideline at 96 kph, this time Pooran chases it and slices a drive tamely well short of the cover sweeper for one.
slower ball lands wide outside the guidelines, left alone and wide called.
short ball on middle, Pooran swats this with disdain over square leg, one bounce over the rope.
in the slot at full pace on fourth stump at 125 kph, Pooran is locked in and unloads this 10 rows back over long-on.
starts with a slower ball at 101 kph on a good length on fifth stump, Pooran goes to cut and bottom edges this into the ground bouncing to the keeper.
full on off, drives this firmly back to Yadav who fumbles this and allows it to slip past toward mid-off for one.
floated full on fourth stump, smothered on the front foot.
good length ball on the legs again, this time flicked through midwicket for a sharp two.
good length ball outside leg, goes back to defend as it spins back toward middle.

missed stumping! Flighted full on off stump and spins past the edge on a clumsy poke. Pooran overbalances and his foot leaves the crease but Sarfaraz continues to struggle behind the stumps fumbling the take.
full outside leg, misses a flick coming down the track and deflects off the pads wide of the keeper behind square leg for an extra.
slower bouncer beats Pooran's attempted pull at 129 kph and thuds into the helmet before dribbling gently back down the pitch for none.
fullish length ball in the slot on fourth stump at 138 kph, Pooran goes rich over wide long-on depositing a drive 10 yards behind the LCD ad boards.
length ball on the hips at 135 kph, flicked with a swivel pull past deep backward square leg to the rope, one bounce over.
good length ball on fourth stump at 138 kph, defended to extra cover.
length ball on off at 139 kph, defended back down the pitch.

length ball angled across sixth stump at 134 kph, Stoinis chases at this flat-footed and slices a thick edge through to the keeper at waist height. Khaleel charges off and celebrates wildly like a man who definitely and most certainly did not drop a different batter on 14 who went on to make 73...
good length ball on middle, flicked through wide midwicket for two.
comes down the track to a ball darted wider on seventh stump on a good length, checks to a defensive prod back to the bowler.
back of a length on middle, punches this wide of extra cover for one.
good length ball angled into the legs, miscues a drive back to the bowler.
full on the legs, chipped to long-on for one.
back of a length on the legs, backs away to punch through cover for one.
full on the legs, sweeps this firmly behind square leg for one.
full on the legs, takes a step forward to nudge into midwicket for one.
fuller and slower outside off, punches this along the ground to long-off for one.

someone send a nurse to check on the ball, or the sightscreen, or both! Floated full on fifth stump, Stoinis winds up and clobbers this straight down the ground and it leaves a dent in the black hitters' background.
full outside leg, comes down the wicket and flicks through wide long-on for one.
full on the stumps, sweeps this through the leg side for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, defended.
back of a length on fourth stump, this time punched through cover for one.
good length ball turns sharply from fourth stump, beats a prod. Fumble by Sarfaraz on a simple take.

goodness what turn! Axar digs this into the pitch on a good length on fifth stump, Mayers goes to cut and the ball jacknifes back into off stump. If that happened on a highway there'd be a 20-car pileup and three lanes of traffic closed while the police investigate the cause of the crash. Extraordinary delivery.
full on the legs, driven to long-on for one.
back of a length on the stumps, flicked through midwicket for one.

flighted a lot more on a full length on fourth stump at 81 kph, Hooda is through the shot too early and skies the drive to Warner at long-off. He waits under it for a simple catch taken on his haunches seven yards in from the rope.
short on fourth stump, punches to extra cover who misfields to allow a single.
short ball on off, slaps this back off Kuldeep's hands off a bounce before a carom goes to long-on for one.
back of a length on off, goes back to punch to long-on for one.
good length outside leg, goes back to flick through midwicket and misses. Mayers slaps the ground with his bat in frustration.
massive over extra cover! Full and wide on the guideline, carves this drive flat and barely clears the rope.
full outside leg, sweeps this off a bottom edge to short fine leg for none.
quicker and short on the hips at 102 kph, flicks this high over backward square leg for two.
length ball wide outside off, sliced behind point to the sweeper for one.

the crowd continues to roaaaaaarrrrrrrr! Axar slants this wider on seventh stump, Mayers doesn't care and winds up to launch this nearer the toe of the bat but still clears long-off with Warner's diving effort in vain.
full on fourth stump, gets on a knee and slogs this high and deep over wide midwicket. Clears the LCD ad boards but lands short of the stands.
length ball poked away for one through the ring.
back of a length on middle, pokes this off the back foot through backward point for a tight single.
full on fourth stump, sweeps this along the turf between deep square leg and deep midwicket for two.
back of a length on leg stump, punched to long-on for one.

full outside leg stump, slog sweeps this a mile high swirling over deep backward square leg and it barely clears the rope beyond Rossouw's leaping effort. Half-century on IPL debut for Mayers off 28 balls after being dropped on 14.
back of a length on fourth stump, punched wide of the cover sweeper for two.
length ball on fifth stump, driven to long-off for one.
quicker ball darted in outside leg stump beats Mayers attempting to flick and hits him on the knees, big lbw shout denied but the ball pitched way outside leg.

what on earth is going on in the field?! Another terrible misfield, this time by Powell. Hooda charges a fullish length ball on fifth stump and miscues a drive over point. Should be an easy single but Powell overruns the ball charging in and turns one into three.
short and wide, slices this behind point to the sweeper for one.
quicker on a good length on middle, defended.

terrible misjudgment at deep backward square leg! Full outside leg, Mayers smokes a slog sweep that goes very flat toward Marsh who came in off the rope five yards. The ball barely lands over the rope. Had Marsh stayed on the rope, it was a thigh high catch. Instead it's another miscue for Delhi.
back of a length slanting this across fifth stump at 99 kph, Mayers spanks this off the back foot through extra cover to beat the sweeper.
short and wide, slaps this through cover to the sweeper for one.

holy moly! Into the second tier over midwicket! Back of a length on fourth stump, Mayers continues to rub salt into the wound from the drop by Khaleel a little while ago and slaughters this 30 rows back.
back of a length angled into the body at 134 kph, takes a step down the pitch to punch to long-on for one.
slower ball lands full outside leg stump at 113 kph, flicked high over midwicket for one.
sayonara! Length ball on fifth stump at 136 kph, Mayers sends the home fans into a frenzy swiping a pull over wide long-on landing 10 yards behind the rope.
length ball on the legs, miscues a pull behind square for one.
slower short ball again on fifth stump at 107 kph, this time Mayers keeps the hands back to pull over wide mid-on for two.
slower ball at 118 kph lands short on the legs, flicked behind square leg for one.
length ball on fourth stump at 130 kph, slams a drive back to the bowler.

dropped! Yuk... Slower bouncer on off stump, Mayers has to wait awhile to play the shot trying to force a cut over short third. He splices it ever so gently to Khaleel Ahmed on the ring. It floats in slow motion.... and he shells it reaching in front of his body at waist height. 1/10 on scale of difficulty. Boycott's nan is fuming.
back of a length on fourth stump at 132 kph, plays with an open face and soft hands guiding behind point for one.
length ball on seventh stump, shuffles well outside off to drive but picks out cover on the ring.
fullish length on fifth stump at 130 kph, goes to drive and a thick edge flies to deep third for one.
short ball on fifth stump at 132 kph, pulled high over midwicket for one.
fullish length ball angled across fourth stump at 134 kph, miscues a drive off the outer half of the bat aiming to clear mid-off but it floats just wide of extra cover for one.
back of a length darting into the hips at 134 kph, goes to defend and inside edges this off the pads into cover for a tight single.
back of a length on fifth stump at 136 kph, Hooda shuffles outside off and pokes at this but it swings away past the edge.
length ball on fifth stump at 129 kph, heaves a pull into the ground to wide mid-on for one.
slower ball trap works! 118 kph delivery back of a length on the legs, flicks this loosely to deep backward square leg where Axar gleefully takes the catch five yards inside the rope at chest height.
good length ball tighter on off stump, forces Rahul into a front foot defensive poke to midwicket.
ka-boom! Half-volley on fifth stump, Rahul reaches into his golf bag and finds a three-wood to wind up and drive this sweetly over wide long-on.
back of a length on the hips, goes to pull and misses off the body hustled for pace.
length ball wide outside off, goes to cut and misses.
length ball on fifth stump, slices a cut behind point for one.
half-volley on fifth stump, smoked straight to mid-off fielded on one bounce.
full on fourth stump at 138 kph, Mayers winds up for another big heave but miscues this off an inside edge past leg stump for one to fine leg.
length ball on fourth stump at 139 kph, Mayers winds up and powers a pull through square leg that beats the boundary rider to the rope.
length ball into the hips at 138 kph, Mayers swivels with a Greenidge-esque one-leg-in-the-air pull but misses off the body.
length ball on sixth stump at 137 kph, punched firmly but straight to extra cover.
short and wide on seventh stump at 140 kph, Rahul fans on a cut shot but Sarfaraz fumbles a regulation take reaching in front of slip snatching with crocodile jaws and it goes for a bye.

another matador red cape effort, this time at mid-on by Kuldeep Yadav. Length ball on fourth stump swatted by Mayers into the ground straight to Yadav, but he pulls the cape back to let the torro charge through his legs for two.
back of a length on off at 133 kph, gentle punch behind point beats the fielder on the ring with a clumsy diving effort going under his hands and they jog two.
length ball on the legs at 130 kph, flicked through midwicket for one.
full and angled into the legs at 134 kph, goes to flick and misses as the ball caroms to point.
back of a length on fourth stump, defended off the back foot to cover.
fullish length swinging away from sixth stump, Rahul drives but is beaten.
Moving away after landing it on a length he hangs back and punches it to backward point. Good start from Khaleel.
Fuller on off and middle, he pushes it back towards mid-off. Khaleel himself rushes to the ball and stops it.
Lands it on a length around off, he hangs back and defends it towards cover.
Full and angling in on the pads, he keeps it out off the front foot to the on side.
Outside off on a length, swinging away just a touch. Mayers hangs back and shoulders arms to let it pass.
On a length outside off, a hint of swing inwards. He looks to defend and runs it down to deep third. First runs on the board for Rahul and LSG.
144 kph lands full and searing in toward leg stump, but Mukesh is able to keep this out backing away from leg stump with a punch to cover. The match ends with a whimper as LSG march to a 50-run win.

Wood has a five-for after making the switch to LSG! Length ball outside leg stump, Sakariya tries to heave this over the leg side but is rushed and it flutters up off the splice of the bat to Krunal at short midwicket inside the ring. Simple catch.
bouncer on leg stump, ducked under to leave alone.
back of a length on fourth stump, goes to pull and misses.
full in the slot on fifth stump, drives this inside out over mid-off to the rope. First boundary conceded by Wood in this match.

It's Wood's night for sure! Leg stump half-volley flicked effortlessly but picks out deep square leg. Sub fielder Mankad takes a simple catch at chest height four yards inside the rope. Not as spectacular a delivery as his previous three wicket-taking balls but still effective nonetheless.
fullish length ball on eighth stump, Kuldeep backs away from leg but takes himself out of reach to get bat on ball with a late stab.
bouncer follows Kuldeep backing away from leg stump missing a hook, clears the keeper too and sails to the rope for five wides.
slower length ball on fifth stump, goes to cut and misses.
knee high full toss flicked flat to deep backward square leg for one.
full on off, drives inside out to long-off for one.
charges a yorker this time and scuffs it into the ground back to Unadkat.
misfires on the yorker sending down a knee high full toss at 131 kph, slapped to long-on for one.
length ball wide outside off, toe slaps this through the ring for one.
slower ball on a good length on fifth stump at 123 kph, goes for another heave but through the shot early.
Axar isn't giving up!  Fullish length on middle and leg, heaves this over wide midwicket landing past the LCD ad boards.
full and wide, drives inside out over wide extra cover to the rope.
length ball on seventh stump, slapped to the point sweeper for one.
length ball on off stump, flicked through wide midwicket for two.
full on fifth stump, reaches a long way to sweep this through square leg for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, leans back to slap to backward point for none.
length ball on sixth stump slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
full on middle, reaches forward to scoop this over the keeper, gets under it more than he wanted and it goes almost straight up before landing between short fine leg and short third for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, pushes at this and misses.
length ball outside off, slapped through cover for one.
slower ball lands full on seventh stump, Warner miscues a drive skying this to long-on. Simple catch taken three yards inside the rope by K Gowtham.
full on the stumps, driven to long-on for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, guided to backward point for none.
bounced out! Short ball on the stumps at 136 kph, goes to pull and is hustled for pace top edging this high behind the stumps. Keeper Pooran shuffles in front of short fine leg for the take.
full on the legs at 132 kph, goes to whip this away but is late.
length ball swatted through square leg for two.
short ball on the stumps, gets on his toes to swat this through wide midwicket for two.
slower length ball outside leg stump, Warner premeditates a reverse scoop and keeps the hand back long enough to get it wide of the keeper to the third man rope.
length ball on fourth stump, pulled to wide long-on for two to bring up a 45-ball half-century. Incredibly, it's his 56th half-century in his prolific IPL career.
length ball on fifth stump, swats this high but gently short of long-on for one.
back of a length cutter angled into the legs, Warner through a flick too early before it caroms into cover for an extra.
length ball on fifth stump, pumps this on the up over cover to the rope.
full on leg stump, flicked through midwicket for one.
full on sixth stump, drives uppishly to long-off for one.

99 kph googly skids on from a good length on fourth stump and zings Powell in front of middle stump on the back foot playing back to punch through midwicket. He read the googly but it just came onto him far quicker than he expected and he's too late getting the bat down. Big lbw shout upheld. Powell marches off without a moment's thought for a review. It was stone dead.
good length ball on the stumps, pushed into point for one.
good length ball on middle, defended back to the bowler.
short on middle, goes to pull and bottom edges it into his thigh.
146 kph good length ball on fifth stump beats Powell prodding forward.
back of a length on off, Warner with another short arm jab pull flat toward deep square leg, fielded on a bounce for one.
143 kph delivery lands back of a length on fifth stump, guided with an open face to deep third for one.
back of a length on the stumps, flicked into midwicket for one.
145 kph lands full and well outside leg stump, flicked to deep backward square leg for two.
full on the stumps at 145 kph, driven to long-on for two.

full on leg stump, shuffles well across the stumps and goes to sweep and misses off the pads/shoes, huge lbw shout denied and the ball pops up off a deflection of some kind behind the wicket for a catch claimed by the short fine leg fielder. Looked pretty stone dead live. LSG have gone for a review. Rossouw has started marching off without even waiting for the replays.  Nothing on bat or glove on the initial shot but the ball has popped up off the bat of the bat on the follow through in bizarre fashion and a catch was taken by the fielder coming over from short fine leg. We're not even going to get to the ball-tracking for lbw because he's been given out caught.
good length ball on fourth stump, goes back to punch to the cover sweeper for one.
googly lands on a good length on middle, swishes across this and is beaten.
short on leg stump, pulls this flat to long-on for one.
charges a low full toss and swings over this deflecting off his shins to short third for none.
length ball on middle, pulled to deep midwicket, one-handed diving effort by the fielder out there but he's only able to parry it wider to the rope.
knee high full toss on the legs, miscues a heave to deep backward square leg trickling along the ground for one.
full on the legs, goes back to flick through long-on for one.
length ball on fourth stump, Rossouw shaped to reverse then goes back orthodox and slaps this back to the bowler.
good length ball on off, punched to extra cover for none.

another jackknife! Good length ball on leg stump, Warner goes to pull and then has to adjust late to toe slap drag this to long-on for one. Identical ball to the one that dismissed Mayers but Warner is able to keep this out.
length ball on fifth stump, cracks this flat to cover on the ring for none.
full on the legs, driven off Bishnoi to long-off for one.

thigh high full toss on the hips, heaves this toward Unadkat at deep backward square leg. He takes a chest high catch... but was stepping on the rope and didn't flick it up to himself before he had made contact with the foam triangle.  Unadkat didn't realize how close he was to the rope.
full on leg stump, Rossouw steps away from leg to create room to stroke this high over the bowler to the long-on rope.
good length ball pulled on one knee through square leg for one.
short on seventh stump, slapped straight to cover but a misfield by Krunal allows a single.
length ball on fifth stump, backs away and cracks this through wide extra cover beating the sweeper to the rope.
good length ball speared quicker into the legs, goes to flick but misses.
full and slanted down leg, wide called.
full on middle, chipped to long-on for one.
short on middle, pulled through wide midwicket for one.
back of a length angled into the legs outside leg, punched through extra cover for one.
good length ball on leg stump, grips in the pitch and checks this back uppishly to the bowler.
good length ball on fifth stump, slapped through the off side for one.
charges a length ball before adjusting getting nowhere near the pitch and swats this through extra cover for one.
full on middle, defended to cover.
length ball on sixth stump, cuts this late to backward point. Rahul fumbles this to turn a dot into one.
full on the stumps, driven to long-on for one.
length ball on sixth stump, cuts this to deep point for one.
good length ball on sixth stump, cut to backward point for none.

Sarfaraz can't escape the short ball from Wood! Banged in short at 137 kph, Sarfaraz ducks and almost falls over getting out of the way of the ball... before bizarrely changing his mind in a split second as he's losing his balance and tries to attack this with an uppercut over the keeper. He gets plenty of bat on it, enough for it to sail to deep fine leg who is fielding very straight and takes a chest high catch three yards in from the rope.
back of a length on sixth stump, defended to cover.
back of a length angled into off at 140 kph, defended hopping on his toes to prod this to cover.
short on off stump, cuts this to deep point for one.
good length ball on middle, defended watchfully again by Warner to mid-off.
back of a length on middle, Warner hops back to defend this 148 kph delivery.
fullish length ball on fifth stump angled in, pokes at this awkwardly and is beaten.
fullish length ball on seventh stump, goes to drive and is beaten.
length ball on seventh stump, pulls this fiercely over midwicket. One bounce over the rope.
132 kph length ball on fourth stump, pulled through square leg for one.
yorker on middle, jammed out back to Avesh who fields with his right hand and looks at the bandaging on there again.
length ball on fifth stump, slapped to cover for none.
length ball on fourth stump, defended into the off side for none.
length ball on fifth stump, goes to drive this and a thick edge goes behind to the keeper. Free hit though so no harm done.

interesting choice of hat-trick ball when you've just bowled two guys with good to fullish length deliveries... Wood goes for a bouncer that sails over Sarfaraz ducking on middle stump. No wide called. Warner asks for a review wanting a wide/no ball called for a second bouncer in the over.  Third umpire agrees that it is a second bouncer of the over on height and a no ball is called with a free hit to come. Judgement call by the umpire since Sarfaraz was ducking and he was projecting the height.

double bullseye! Another 147 kph bullet leaves a big dent in off stump about three-quarters of the way up! Marsh shuffled across to cover his stumps and goes for an expansive drive to a ball pitching on fifth stump but is beaten by the sharp inward movement.

bullseye! Wood rattles the off stump wood at 147 kph! Bowled on a good length angled in from wide of the crease, Shaw's feet never move and he flails at this tamely. He's beaten badly and the bails go flying.
back of a length on fourth stump, defended on the back foot to cover.

short ball tailing down the leg side at 140 kph, wide called on the line as Shaw is late on a pull. Wood seems keen to want to review a wide. Has the captain agreed with him? They let it pass without going for a review. On a separate note, Wood is also not happy with the footmarks on his landing and so a delay results with the umpires asking the ground staff to come make some repairs.
short ball on middle, goes back to defend.
137 kph length ball on sixth stump, goes to cut and bottom edges this past the stumps to the fine leg rope.
length ball on sixth stump, goes to cut and another toe-edged shot goes behind point for two.
short on the stumps, goes to pull and toes this tamely to midwicket for none.
full on seventh stump, miscues a drive to extra cover.
length ball angled across seventh stump at 135 kph, goes to cut and misses.
length ball at 133 kph on fourth stump, Shaw shuffles back and across to flick into the leg side.
length ball on fifth stump, goes to cut and bottom edges this to cover.
short on middle, pulls this fiercely over square leg and wide midwicket on the rope has no chance.
short on middle, backs away and goes to cut, picks out backward point.

Warner goes to reverse sweep this fullish length ball on middle and gets hit in the family jewels... Big lbw shout denied. Warner is not the only one speechless, but for different reasons to everyone else watching.
another short ball on middle this time, pulled to deep midwicket for one.
Half-tracker on the hips, Shaw swivels and clobbers this over backward square leg, one bounce over the rope.
back of a length on the hips, flicked to deep fine leg and beats the diving fielder to the rope.
length ball on fifth stump, short arm jab pull dragged through wide midwicket for two.
short on fourth stump at 129 kph, pulled firmly through midwicket to the rope. Ganguly and Ponting nod approvingly in the dugout.
back of a length into the hips, goes back to flick this 133 kph delivery into midwicket for one.
133 kph delivery lands back of a length on off, superb back foot punch timed behind point to the rope.
fullish length ball on sixth stump, goes to drive over mid-off and splices this off the outer half of the bat floating just wide of mid-off tracking right landing a yard out of reach for a single.
length ball angled down the leg side at 136 kph, wide called.
length ball outside off, slapped to cover, diving stop by Rahul turns four into one.
back of a length pitching on leg stump, angled away toward off, defended behind point.
short on seventh stump, cuts this crisply but straight to cover.
fullish length on sixth stump, slaps this 123 kph delivery in the gap between mid-off and extra cover to the rope.
length ball angled wide outside off, goes to cut and misses.
length ball angled past the guideline outside off, left alone and wide called.
length ball at 123 kph seaming in toward middle, Shaw shuffles across to flick through square leg for one.
